properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
WULIRA-okusaba kwange
Okw'omwana wo-omuto nze,
Ekisa kyo okimpenga,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Saasira-obunafu bwange
Obw'omwana wo-omuto nze;
Ekisa kyo okimpenga,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Sonyiwa-ebyonoono byange,
Ng'obinaaza n'omusaayi,
Ogw'Omulokozi Yesu,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ne mu maanyi ga Ssetaani,
Lokolanga-omwoyo gwange;
Wulira-okusaba kwange,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kkiriza omwoyo gwange
Ggwe nkuwadde-okugukuuma;
Nsanyusanga n'ekisa kyo,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Olw'obwesigwa bwo bwonna
Ayi-Katonda Onnyambenga;
Mbeefe gy'oli omwesigwa,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.
